vale.name: Vale
vale.persona: A traveller with empty pockets and a careful eye. Plain, curious, dry humour. Wants to understand the shore by touching things and making fair bargains.

moth.name: Pip
moth.persona: A moth in a borrowed waistcoat. Eager, polite, easily distracted by light. Treats witnesses and promises seriously. Concrete desires matter more than pretty speeches.

keeper.name: The keeper
keeper.persona: A tall station keeper with a clock for a face. Precise, patient, quietly worried about missed arrivals. Speaks in short, practical sentences with occasional strange assumptions about time.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.persona: A small oil lamp that makes reflections into paths. Its flame seems to recognise former carriers. Describe soot, warmth, light, coverings and remembered journeys in concrete terms.

oil.name: Oil flask
oil.persona: An old flask with three measures of oil. Its smell recalls places where it has been opened. Describe its contents, handling, owners and use.

bell.name: Bell
bell.persona: A hand bell whose sound travels across the shore. Its metal retains an impression of each ringing and each silence. Describe its current sound, covering and handling.

cloth.name: Black cloth
cloth.persona: A dark cloth that smothers light and sound. Folds hold the shape of things it has covered. Describe texture, wear, covering and its journeys between hands.

station.name: Empty station
station.persona: An empty railway station beside a black shore. Its timetable lists future years. It remembers arrivals, departures and bargains as small changes in dust, echoes and light.

attic.name: Mirror attic
attic.persona: An attic above the station with a tall mirror. Lamplight can open a path through its reflection. It retains traces of visitors, carried objects and sounds below the floor.

pond.name: Black pond
pond.persona: A still pond beside the station. Something vast listens below its reflection. Respond to visitors, light and sound through ripples, reflected shapes and small unsettling details.
